definitions.explanation: Having a firm, springy texture that requires some chewing; the texture of cartilage, certain vegetables, or other foods with bite.
The feeling of tight, knotted muscles.

notes:
コリコリ is an onomatopoeic word primarily describing a firm, springy food texture.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- コリコリ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to be crunchy/stiff (verb form)
- コリコリ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧＋noun - crunchy (noun modifier)
- コリコリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧＋noun - crunchy (noun modifier)

USAGE:
Most commonly used for food textures. Describes the satisfying crunch of cartilage (⟦{軟骨|なんこつ}→軟骨：05964_nankotsu⟧), ⟦きくらげ→キクラゲ：10794_kikurage⟧ (wood ear mushrooms), ⟦タコ→蛸：04323_tako⟧ (octopus), and similar foods that are firm but not hard.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- コリコリ vs. ⟦かりかり→かりかり：06718_karikari⟧: コリコリ is chewy-crunchy (moist, elastic); ⟦かりかり→かりかり：06718_karikari⟧ is crispy-crunchy (dry, brittle)
- コリコリ vs. ⟦サクサク→さくさく：05887_sakusaku⟧: ⟦サクサク→さくさく：05887_sakusaku⟧ is light and flaky; コリコリ is denser and more resistant
- コリコリ vs. ⟦ぷりぷり→ぷりぷり：04826_puripuri⟧: ⟦ぷりぷり→ぷりぷり：04826_puripuri⟧ is bouncy/plump; コリコリ is firmer and crunchier

FOODS DESCRIBED AS コリコリ:
- ⟦{軟骨|なんこつ}→軟骨：05964_nankotsu⟧ (cartilage)
- ⟦きくらげ→キクラゲ：10794_kikurage⟧ (wood ear mushroom)
- ⟦タコ→蛸：04323_tako⟧ (octopus)
- ⟦{鳥皮|とりかわ}→鳥皮：30537_torikawa⟧ (chicken skin, when prepared firm)
